title: Minimum Subarray Length With Distinct Sum At Least K
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the minimum length of a subarray whose sum of distinct values (each value counted once) is at least k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the minimum length of a subarray whose sum of distinct values (each value counted once) is at least k. If no such subarray exists, return -1.
constraints: nums contains up to 100,000 positive integers and k is positive.
A window score sums each distinct value exactly once.
Return the shortest score-at-least-k window, or -1 when none exists.
hints: Positive values make the distinct-value score nondecreasing when extending right and nonincreasing when removing left.
Track window frequencies and add or subtract a value only when its frequency crosses zero.
For every right endpoint, shrink left while the score stays at least k and record lengths.
The final feasible window before each shrink failure is the shortest for that right endpoint; scanning all endpoints finds the global minimum.
editorial: The final feasible window before each shrink failure is the shortest for that right endpoint; scanning all endpoints finds the global minimum.

tests.explanation: The length-two window [2,3] has distinct sum five.
A single value five already reaches the target.
